title: Inbox Zero means an empty inbox.
description:
Inbox Zero means an empty inbox. The man who named it does not keep his empty, and says that reading misses the whole point. The zero was never the message count.

On his site 43 Folders, "finding the time and attention to do your best creative work", he coined Inbox Zero. The zero he meant was the attention you cede to email, not the number of messages in the box.

Turn each message into an action, fast, then leave. That is the series' actual advice: convert mail to a next step as quickly as you can, and stop refreshing. Zero minutes with your brain stuck in the inbox, not zero emails.

Mailbox gamified hitting zero. A cheerful "You're all done" over a changing photo, every time you emptied the box. Dropbox bought Mailbox and shut it down in 2016. The number won; the point was lost.

In 2020 the inventor admitted his own inbox is full.
